name: smwmusic-touhou-gensoukyou-lotus-land-story-the-inevitably-forbidden-game
title: Touhou Gensoukyou ~ Lotus Land Story - The Inevitably Forbidden Game
description:
The extra stage theme from the fourth PC-98 Touhou game. Suitable for long, spacy levels near end-game.

The MML file is cross-compiled from a different MML dialect using a custom Lua script, and then manually optimized.
